{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) is outraged but not surprised at the failure of the St. Louis County grand jury to indict Officer Darren Wilson for the killing of Michael Brown.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The structural bias in the judicial and criminal justice system favors police who engage in violent action against unarmed Black and Brown people.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The outcome of the grand jury was unsurprising, yet enraging.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An unarmed person can be killed by an armed police officer without there being a case for a criminal prosecution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Tens of thousands of individuals across the country protested in the streets after the announcement of the grand jury verdict.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA joins others in demanding that the Federal Department of Justice continue its investigation into the conduct of the Ferguson police department.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA demands investigation into the possible violation of Michael Brown’s civil rights by Officer Wilson and the department.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
